title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Financial report changes are now always logged
summary: Financial report changes in Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29) are now automatically logged in the change log without requiring manual setup, making it easier to audit modifications to financial row, column, and report definitions.
key_points: Changes to financial row, column, and report definitions are automatically recorded in the change log
No manual activation of the change log is required for financial reports
Users can track who modified what in financial reports and when, helping identify accidental changes
The change log entries are chronologically ordered and show all direct modifications to tracked data
features: Automatic change logging for financial reports
Change log auditing without manual setup

quotes.text: Changes to financial row, column, and report definitions are automatically recorded in the change log for easier auditing.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the core feature that eliminates manual setup and automatically protects against accidental changes to financial reports
